title: ptelea trifoliata var. pentaphilla
intro: Ptelea trifoliata var. pentaphilla, commonly known as the five-leafed prickleback, is a variety of the prickleback plant, a type of flowering plant in the Rutaceae family. The health benefits of Ptelea trifoliata var. pentaphilla include its potential to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its ability to act as a diuretic and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative, anti-spasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which can help to calm the nervous system, relieve muscle spasms, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of Ptelea trifoliata var. pentaphilla include limonoids, coumarins, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
